results.reasoning: Paternal great-grandfather (ab ab al-ab) with granddaughter (bint ibn) present: takes 1/6 fard per Quran 4:11 plus remainder as asaba. Option D correctly states 1/6.
Father's paternal uncle (amm al-ab li-ab) is blocked (mahjub) by the closer paternal uncle (amm li-ab) who is nearer in degree among the asaba.
Single daughter with no son to make her asaba inherits 1/2 (al-nisf) per Quran 4:11.
Son of father's uncle (ibn amm al-ab) is blocked by grandson (ibn ibn) who is a male descendant, and also by grandfather (ab al-ab) and paternal brother (akh li-ab).
Father's uncle (amm al-ab) is blocked (mahjub) by the grandfather (ab al-ab) who is a closer male ascendant.
Paternal sister with grandfather (ab ab al-ab): following Jumhur position, sister shares with grandfather as asaba. After grandfather's 1/6 fard and grandmother's 1/6, sister takes the remainder.
Granddaughter (bint ibn) is blocked (mahjub) when a son (ibn) is present, as the son is a higher-degree male descendant.
Maternal grandmother (umm al-umm) is a valid grandmother (jadda sahiha) and takes 1/6 as her prescribed share.
Full brother (akh shaqiq) takes the remainder (baqi al-tarika) as the nearest male agnate (asaba) after mother takes her share.
Son of full brother (ibn akh shaqiq) is the closest asaba by degree and strength among the listed heirs. Takes remainder after grandmother's 1/6.
With a son present: grandmother 1/6, son takes remainder. All siblings, uncles, and their descendants are blocked by the son.
Great-grandfather (ab ab al-ab) with male great-grandson (ibn ibn ibn) present: grandfather takes 1/6 fard only, per Quran 4:11.

Son of paternal uncle (ibn amm li-ab) is blocked (mahjub) by the closer son of son of paternal brother (ibn ibn akh li-ab) who is in a higher asaba category (brothers' descendants before uncles' descendants).
Father's uncle (amm al-ab) is blocked (mahjub) by the father (ab) who blocks all collateral relatives.
Paternal grandmother (umm ab al-ab) gets 1/6, wives get 1/4, paternal brother and sister share remainder as asaba (male gets double female share). Nephews blocked by brother.
Wife gets 1/8 (with descendant), grandson (ibn ibn) takes remainder as asaba. Base = 8 shares. Others blocked.
Father 1/6, grandmother 1/6, 3 sons share remainder. Base 6: father 1, grandmother 1, sons share 4. Correction: 6×3=18 total. Each son = 4 shares after correction. Granddaughters blocked by sons.
Grandfather with 2 full brothers (Jumhur muqasama): maternal brothers blocked by grandfather. 3 equal asaba (grandfather + 2 brothers) share entire estate. Base 3, each gets 1 share.
Father takes remainder as asaba (no descendant), wife gets 1/4. All others blocked by father. Base = 4. No correction needed.
Paternal grandmother 1/6, maternal half-brothers blocked by male descendant, wives 1/8, great-grandson takes remainder. LCM(6,8) = 24 shares.
Two grandmothers share 1/6 (each gets 1 share after correction to base 12). 2 sons of paternal brother share remainder (5 shares each after correction). Others blocked. Base 6 × 2 = 12.
Mother 1/6 (blocks both grandmothers), 2 daughters 2/3, great-grandson takes remainder. Base = 6.

Two grandmothers share 1/6. With grandsons and wives: base = LCM(6,8) = 24. Grandmothers' share = 24/6 = 4 shares.
Grandmother 1/6 = 1 share, great-granddaughters (2) 2/3 = 4 shares, maternal sister blocked by female descendant, paternal uncle takes remainder = 1 share. Base 6.

Wives get 1/8, grandsons (ibn ibn) take remainder as asaba. Great-granddaughters blocked by higher-degree grandson. Base = 8.
Female deceased: husband gets 1/4 (with sons), grandmother 1/6, sons take remainder. LCM(4,6) = 12. Husband = 12/4 = 3 shares.
